message: Plants were well packed and arrived safely and in excellent shape. Super fast shipping too. I highly recommend this shop. I will be back again.
I can’t say enough about this product!!!! My skin loves it!! I love it!!! I highly recommend everyone try it!!

I’m absolutely in love with this product!! I use it morning and night daily!! It doesn’t clog pores, can be applied with my moisturizer and there’s no greasy feeling. Doesn’t cake my makeup. Over all a great product!!! Highly recommended!!!

The package came quick and very well packaged! Seller had great communication and answered all questions in a timely manner. The serum feels amazing on my face, I’m confident I’ll be purchasing again!

This is my first review on Etsy but I just had to leave one for this seller because my vanilla orchid is GORGEOUS. I have been on a streak of buying plants from various sellers and this is the best by far. Beautiful variation, well packaged, and so healthy. The seller was so thoughtful when I asked a question about trailing vs staking before I ordered.
Plants came in healthy and happy. I can’t wait to see how they grow!
Plants arrived in great condition. Excited to see them grow. As usual, they included plant food for a successful start. Received a goodie for being a returning customer, an amazing surprise.
3 beautiful vanilla orchids, amazing variegation & wonderfully packed. thank u!
healthy plants arrived quickly, beautifully packaged and very secure.
My plants arrived in a week and they were green and healthy. The seller really paid attention to detail and labeled plants with cute stickers and even sent some fertilizer to help with transplanting.
Plants look amazing! Seller has been extremely responsive answering my questions on how to care for these beautiful plants. Can’t wait to buy more from this shop!
Excellent condition. VERY well packaged. Arrived in perfect health.

Banana plant arrived in time, seller provided great service and communication, I was able to select my plant, received a lot of freebies and goodies. Definitely recommend if you are considering to purchase.
The plants arrived absolutely perfect condition. Even in very low temps with no heat pack they did great! Will definitely order again
The cutest orchid ever!! Arrived in perfect condition, still moist even, securely wrapped and labeled with lots of extra goodies to give it a boost. Great customer service as well!
